material_conflicts: Aggregate sign differs: CryptoETF.today positive; Maketo negative; CryptoKeyhole negative.
XRPC sign differs: CryptoETF.today and Maketo positive; CryptoKeyhole negative.
Bitwise outflow magnitude differs across providers.
Fund universes differ: 3/5, provider-reported 5/5, and 3/4 daily-collected with GXRP excluded.
Publication timestamps, issuer file dates, prior-session comparisons and USD valuation prices are not harmonized.
xrp_etf_flow_observations.source_independence: All three are secondary aggregators likely relying on overlapping issuer holdings data. They are not three independent primary confirmations.
resolution_required: Obtain and hash each issuer's raw holdings file for the 2026-10-30 US session.
Normalize issuer file timestamp, effective holdings date and prior-session comparison date.
Calculate XRP-unit changes before USD conversion.
Convert using a common documented benchmark and preserve issuer NAV-based values separately.
Keep GXRP and XRPR in explicit separate coverage categories rather than treating missing or excluded funds as zero.

prediction.reason: The ETF flow sources conflict in sign, fund universe, file date alignment and USD valuation. SBI/RLUSD distribution announcements do not disclose net XRP purchases or collateral balances.
